function connect(root) {
    if (!root) return null; // if the tree is empty, return null
    let queue = [root]; // initialize a queue with the root node
    while (queue.length > 0) { // while there are nodes in the queue
        let size = queue.length; // get the number of nodes at the current level
        for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) { // for each node at the current level
            let node = queue.shift(); // remove the node from the queue
            if (i < size - 1) node.next = queue[0]; // if it's not the last node, set its next pointer to the next node
            if (node.left) queue.push(node.left); // if the node has a left child, add it to the queue
            if (node.right) queue.push(node.right); // if the node has a right child, add it to the queue
        }
    }
    return root; // return the root of the modified tree
}

function minSubArrayLen(target, nums) {
  let left = 0, // initialize left pointer of the sliding window
      minLen = Infinity, // initialize minimum length as infinity
      currSum = 0; // initialize current sum as 0
  for (let right = 0; right < nums.length; right++) { // iterate over the array with the right pointer
    currSum += nums[right]; // add the current element to the current sum
    while (currSum >= target) { // if the current sum is greater than or equal to the target
      minLen = Math.min(minLen, right - left + 1); // update the minimum length
      currSum -= nums[left]; // subtract the leftmost element from the current sum
      left++; // move the left pointer to the right
    }
  }
  return minLen === Infinity ? 0 : minLen; // return the minimum length or 0 if no such subarray exists
}

function maxProfit(prices) {
  let buy = -Infinity, sell = 0, cooldown = 0; // initialize variables to track maximum profit
  for (let i = 0; i < prices.length; i++) { // iterate through each day's price
    let newBuy = Math.max(buy, cooldown - prices[i]); // calculate maximum profit if we buy on this day
    let newSell = Math.max(sell, buy + prices[i]); // calculate maximum profit if we sell on this day
    let newCooldown = Math.max(cooldown, sell); // calculate maximum profit if we cooldown on this day
    buy = newBuy; // update buy variable
    sell = newSell; // update sell variable
    cooldown = newCooldown; // update cooldown variable
  }
  return sell; // return maximum profit
}

function subarraySum(nums, k) {
  var count = 0; // initialize count of subarrays with sum equals to k
  var sum = 0; // initialize sum of current subarray
  var hash = {0: 1}; // initialize hash map to store prefix sums
  for (var i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) { // iterate over the array
    sum += nums[i]; // add current element to sum
    if (hash[sum - k]) count += hash[sum - k]; // if sum - k exists in hash, increment count
    if (!hash[sum]) hash[sum] = 0; // if sum does not exist in hash, initialize it to 0
    hash[sum]++; // increment count of sum in hash
  }
  return count; // return total count of subarrays with sum equals to k
}

    if (n === 1 || n === 2) return 1; // base cases for T1 and T2
    let a = 0, b = 1, c = 1; // initialize variables for Tn, Tn+1, and Tn+2
    for (let i = 3; i <= n; i++) { // iterate from T3 to Tn
        let temp = a + b + c; // calculate Tn+3
        a = b; // update Tn
        b = c; // update Tn+1
        c = temp; // update Tn+2
    }
    return c; // return the value of Tn
}
